component.name: Fretcraft
component.summary: Learn guitar harmony, voice leading and ear training

description.p: Fretcraft is a desktop practice studio for guitarists who want to understand harmony rather than memorise shapes. It is made by Arswerk, an independent studio in Italy, and sold directly from arswerk.it.
Fifteen modules cover the ground between a chord chart and actually hearing what you are playing:

ul.li: Voice Leading Lab — pick a key and a chord, then move between voicings with the smoothest connections scored for you
Ear Training — intervals, chord quality, inversions and progressions, played on real guitar voicings rather than piano tones
Exercises Generator — practice studies written over real chord changes, with right-hand fingering, a position plan and tab
Scales Lab — any scale across the whole neck, the chords it builds, and a drone to play it against
Chord Progression Generator — progressions shaped by style, section and a tension curve you draw yourself
Counterpoint and Harmonizer workshops, Fretboard Mastery, a chromatic tuner, a practice-routine timer and a progress system

description.p: Everything is played by a physically modelled nylon-string guitar that runs natively rather than in the browser engine: each string has its own stiffness and decay, the plucking point follows the fretting hand, and the body resonates behind it. Two voicings of the same chord sound different, because on a real guitar they are.
Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Japanese. Fretcraft works offline; it contacts the network only to check your licence and for updates.

description.p: No camera prompt on Linux; .rpm and .deb are the Linux downloads.

ul.li: Fixed: the app asked for the camera on Linux. Audio inputs are now listed only on request
Linux ships as .rpm and .deb, which use the system WebKit and graphics; the AppImage is withdrawn
Every module plays the same physically modelled nylon-string guitar; each string has its own stiffness and decay, and a body resonates behind them
Fretcraft runs on Linux: AppImage, .deb, .rpm and this Flatpak
Saved chord progressions show every voicing on the neck
Fixed: the tuner crashed on open; dropdowns were unreadable on Linux; the tuner asked for the camera

description.p: Harmony corrections, ear training and exercise options.

ul.li: A single chord no longer decides the key when judging whether a chord is diatonic
Progression ear training is voiced in root position by default, with a toggle for random voicings
Generated exercises can be restricted to a fret range
Fretboards are drawn with real fret spacing and graduated string gauges
